name: Offer Studio · offer for a lead

nodes.name: Lead (webhook)
nodes.notes: The landing generator posts JSON here. Connect Gmail, Fireflies and Gaius Meet as more triggers into the Brief node.

nodes.name: CRM: what we already know (after the hackathon)
nodes.notes: Disabled for the hackathon. Later: client data from the CRM fills in the brief (segment, role, call history). A disabled node passes data through unchanged.

nodes.name: Do we know anything?
nodes.notes: True: there is text (email, transcript, note), so the AI analyzes it. False: we know nothing, the offer uses defaults.

nodes.name: Analyze lead (AI)
nodes.notes: Offer Studio asks Claude for the segment, decision-maker role and concerns. An error (e.g. no API key) does not stop the offer: the plan falls back to defaults.

nodes.name: Pick arguments (AI)
nodes.notes: Claude picks the Why Vault? cards for the client's concerns. Without a key the base offer's cards stay.

nodes.name: Offer from a lead?
nodes.notes: The public link serves only offers this workflow created, not any offer in Offer Studio.
